question: What post-subagent completion hook contract should OpenClaw support, and how should it bound child output/history exposure plus announcement mutation, suppression, and delivery-result visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but payload, ordering, timeout/error handling, redaction, audit behavior, and plugin authority are security-sensitive public API choices that automation should not lock in.

options.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
options.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Lifecycle Design
options.body: Hold this specific request until the broader lifecycle hook design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454 settles a single event model across subagents, turns, and tool thresholds.

options.title: Observation-Only Event
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and current snapshot blame make steipete the strongest available owner for the hook API/security boundary choice.
